query_formula.joint: drug AND role_filter AND event AND date_range

generator.panel_inputs: drug, reaction, date_from, and date_to in panels.json
generator.meddra_profile: openFDA reaction PT text as served on extraction date; API exposes no MedDRA version

role_semantics: drugcharacterization=1 includes PS and SS and is not same-object-bound
purpose: offline algorithm regression and publication drift detection
limitations: These aggregate panels do not prove exact primary-suspect binding.
The live aggregate API does not expose quarterly source-file hashes or its MedDRA version; exact quarterly-file regression must use the indexed snapshot backend.
Exact same-drug-object semantics are tested separately with faers_report_binding.json.
Publication values are observational reference anchors, not clinical causality gold standards.
The supplemental multi-drug panels freeze current openFDA latest-report aggregates; exact paper reproduction still requires the paper-matched raw quarterly snapshot.
Paper EBGM/IC interval implementations are not assumed equivalent to this project's fitted-capable GPS-v2/BCPNN implementation.
